operation.description:
Gets the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Get the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/oidc-custom-sub-rep.description: Actions OIDC subject customization for a repository

include_claim_keys.description: Array of unique strings. Each claim key can only contain alphanumeric characters and underscores.

sub_claim_prefix.description: The current `sub` claim prefix for this repository.

use_default.description: Whether to use the default template or not. If `true`, the `include_claim_keys` field is ignored.

use_immutable_subject.description: Whether the repository has opted in to the immutable OIDC subject claim format. When `true`, OIDC tokens will use a stable, repository-ID-based `sub` claim. If not set at the repository level, falls back to the organization-level setting.

#/components/schemas/oidc-custom-sub-rep.title: Actions OIDC subject customization for a repository
